mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weak economic growth, depressing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) above 500 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 350000 signals robust consumer and business demand, boosting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST exceeds 500 and RSAFS exceeds 350000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic momentum and impending monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods within the late-cycle expansion regime where INDPRO declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A declining consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflation, reducing the risk of premature monetary tightening and supporting equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, increasing recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 90.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.1 percentage points and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 220) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1 percentage points in 3 months and CPIAUCSL < 220
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1 percentage points and CPIAUCSL is below 220.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime, strong payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals robust consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly.
